archetypes.name: Mini Flour & Dal Mill
archetypes.description: Small-scale grain and pulse milling unit catering to 3-5 surrounding villages for custom milling and packaged retail flour/dal.
archetypes.raw_material_dependency: Local wheat, gram, and pigeon pea from local farmers and village weekly haats

archetypes.name: Rural Micro Dairy (2-Cow Unit)
archetypes.description: High-yield indigenous/cross-bred cow dairy unit producing 20-25 litres of milk daily supplied to village dairy cooperative societies and local tea stalls.
archetypes.raw_material_dependency: Green fodder from grazing lands, dry fodder (kadbi), and compound cattle feed

archetypes.name: Chilly & Spice Grinding Unit
archetypes.description: Custom spice pulverizer processing turmeric, coriander, and dry red chillies for local farm households, restaurants, and retail haats.
archetypes.raw_material_dependency: Whole whole dry chillies, turmeric bulbs, cumin from local APMC mandis

archetypes.name: Modern Terracotta & Pottery Unit
archetypes.description: Traditional clay pottery enhanced with motorized pottery wheel and energy-efficient kiln for earthen cookware, decorative pottery, and festival items.
archetypes.raw_material_dependency: Local tank silt clay, red clay, firewood/biomass fuel, and organic pigments

archetypes.name: Solar Pump & Farm Machinery Repair Service
archetypes.description: Mobile service enterprise providing doorstep maintenance, solar pump invertor repairs, drip irrigation tuning, and farm electrical servicing.
archetypes.raw_material_dependency: Solar pump controllers, fuses, MCBs, brass connectors, and wire harnesses

archetypes.name: Cold-Pressed Mustard/Groundnut Oil Expeller
archetypes.description: Traditional wooden/stone cold-pressed (Kachi Ghani) oil extraction plant producing pure unrefined mustard and groundnut cooking oil.
archetypes.raw_material_dependency: Locally harvested mustard, groundnut, and sesame seeds from farmers

archetypes.name: Modernized Rural Provision & Agrochemical Store
archetypes.description: Multi-utility retail store combining daily groceries, fast-moving consumer goods, cattle minerals, and organic agricultural inputs.
archetypes.raw_material_dependency: FMCG distributors at district headquarters, wholesale grain mandi traders
